notes.title: Episode 9 and improved cutscenes (Update 1.9)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=r56terBPknU;full][/previewyoutube] 

This update brings episode 9 to the game! 
In this episode, you can play as new super powerful versions of Ice Cream Pachinly and the Pumpkin Master! 

Additionally, new cutscenes have been added to preexisting levels, and preexisting cutscenes have been extended and improved. 

There are also some minor balance tweaks and bugfixes included in the update as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/9b19607723d3cd0dd7de820812bbd03ed9b13135.png

Pachinly Games is now an official LLC! We have more games and updates to Ice Cream Pachinly coming soon! Subscribe to us on our website to keep up to date, and get exclusive digital rewards! 

https://www.pachinlygames.com/

notes.title: Update 1.8 VFX Update
notes.content:
Pachinly is back with his biggest and flashiest update yet! It includes
-Episode 8!
-Brand new vfx!
-Improved character selection screen!
-Instantly unlocked Halloween hats!
-Rebalance of character abilities and enemies to make the game more enjoyable! 
-Lots of bug fixes!

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
Story: 
-Added Co-op to episode 7
-Removed Gun clowns from episode 7
-Reworked episode 5 UI
-Fixed a bug that caused episode 1 to end as soon as the objective was completed
-Fixed enemy falling through the floor at the start of episode 1
-Fixed cotton candy thrower spawning at the start of episode 1
-Fixed some random sounds in the cutscenes for episode's 2 and 3
-The game now displays what difficulty you are on at the level select screen 


Endless:
-Add Glargs bases making a 6th possible map for endless mode
-Aliens from episode 7 can now spawn in endless mode
-The game now displays what difficulty you are on at the character select screen
-Ms.Fortune now spawns in the middle of endless maps
-Fixed endless sometimes loading into co-op when playing single-player
-Fixed cameras not following the players when playing endless co-op on the apple farm map
-Fixed endless loading screens that would sometimes occur when loading into endless mode 
 

Achievements/Hats: 
The way achievements are tracked has been reworked to be more accurate. You can currently earn 18 out of the game's 20 achievements. You can unlock 3 out of the game's 4 hat sets by earning achievements.

Circus of Doom:
-Fixed McChunkin Donut freezing when his target is killed
-Fixed a graphical glitch that appeared when McChunkin Donut attacked in endless mode
-Removed an animation that caused knife clown models to glitch out
-Adjusted gun clown hitboxes
-Fixed a bug that made Backstabby's Imp clowns unkillable on easy difficulty 

other changes:
-Fixed some relics displaying incorrect icons
-Changed text to make it clear that the difficulty screen is showing a high score and not the total score
-Fixed the main menu button causing an endless loading screen during co-op
-Ponsai is now properly affected by movement speed modifiers 
-Pumpkin turrets have had their health bar moved up
-Collison has been added to the sword in the barrel

notes.title: Update 1.6!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/89ec68866cea3c5168cec4e128ac1cd449970a72.png
Difficulties! 
You can now choose between 3 different difficulties. Your story progress and endless score is tracked separately for each difficulty. Achievement progress is shared across all difficulties, with only some of the endless score Achievements now requiring a certain difficulty!

In easy mode Player health is increased, enemy health is increased, and less enemies can be spawned in at once! Best for those who just want to experience the story

In normal mode gameplay is unmodified! The right level of challenge

In hard mode Player health is decreased, enemy health is increased, and more enemies can be spawned at once! A brutal challenge for those who want to flex their gaming skills!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/879a1d8504ce787eacb148ae62c116ef56d58423.png

Achievements! 
3 More achievements have been added to help you unlock some hats:
-The Powers of the knight: As Pachinly use cone shield to prevent a total of 100 damage
-An Apple a day: As Ponsai damage enemies with placed apples 200 times;
-Total score 9000: Earn a total score of 9000 in endless mode on any difficulty


Some achievements have also had difficulty requirements added
-Total Score 1000 Must now be completed in hard difficulty 
-High Score 100 Must now be completed in hard difficulty 
-Total Score 3000 can not be completed in easy difficulty 
-High Score 300 can not be completed in easy difficulty 

Other fixes/Improvements!:
-Episode 6 can now be played in split-screen co-op!
-The funhouse maze can now be chosen as an endless map. Meaning there are now 5 possible maps
-Moved the achievement and hat tracker to the difficulty select screen!
-reworked objective UI in episode 6
-fixed a bug that caused hex effects to not trigger when playing as certain characters
-Added sound effects when hexed
-removed damage stacking from hex 
-Fixed a bug causing you to not properly get your starting Ice cream bonuses in endless
-fixed a bug causing you to sometimes spawn in as the genie instead of Pachinly
-fixed shaders not being applied to Troy's Guitar in certain cutscenes
-fixed cotton candy enemies throwing no projectile
-rebalanced watcher spawn rates in endless

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
Endless: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/5b5d36c770567c512165f0d4b609fbaf8d6140f7.png
-Rebalanced how score is earned in endless
-Added co-op to endless
-Your total score of every round of endless you ever play is now tracked
-For every 100 points in your highscore you start with extra Ice Cream
-For every 1000 points in your total score you start with extra Ice Cream
-Added the haunted woods as a possible endless map
-rebalanced scoring to keep score gains in coop in line with those in singleplayer

You can earn the following 10 Achievements: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/879a1d8504ce787eacb148ae62c116ef56d58423.png
-Free Cotton Candy: Defeat 200 Cotton Candy enemies 
-HighScore 100: Get a highscore of 100 in endless mode
-HighScore 300: Get a highscore of 300 in endless mode  
-HighScore 300: Get a highscore of 900 in endless mode  
-TotalScore 1000: Get a total score of 1000 in endless mode
-TotalScore 3000: Get a total score of 1000 in endless mode
-I’m the guitar legend: Play a sick guitar solo as Troy Collins
-I Never said I was good or heroic: Use soul drain to restore 1000 health as pumpkin master
-Rookie Hero: Earn 4 achievements. Unlocks Hat set 1
-True Hero: Earn 9 Achievements. Unlocks Hat set 2

Hats:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/da9d330da6696c51d2a03edb79f065dd2e1f4304.png
By earning the hero Achievements you unlock hats. Hats can be freely changed during gameplay and your last used hats will appear on the characters during cutscenes as well! 


Balancing: 
-Made episodes 1-3 a little easier to help players get into the game.
-Pumpkin Master: Soul drain healing is now longer boosted by the cider barrel 
-Troy: Guitar play damage is now longer boosted by the sword in the barrel
-Ms.Fortune: Increased the size of her shield
-All bosses: Now drop apple pie when defeated
-Backstabby: The knives he drops now properly add a damage boost. This boost has been changed to melee only. 

Bugfixes:
-Fixed a glitch that caused Ms.Fortune no longer not seek out the player in endless
-Fixed a glitch that caused Fierce Joe to freeze after killing his target
-Fixed a glitch that caused the incorrect ice cream cost to appear on the sword in a barrel
-Fixed clown imps not disappearing on death

notes.title: Episode 7 is out now! (Update 1.4)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/b44f496ede371fb4e5d0215164a4b98bfc2c107f.png
Episode 7: Attack on Glarg's base is out now! Only 3 more episodes remain!

Story: 
-Added episode 7
-Added Co-op play to episode 5
-Added some extra voice lines to episodes 5 & 6

Playable Characters:
-Pumpkin Master's pumpkin of power ability has been replaced with a new ability called cursed power
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/0c34bf321cb2df1e4967ebe85a3de19300d24dd0.png
-Cursed Power: While active pumpkin master deals more damage and moves faster, but constantly drains health. It costs 3 Ice Cream to toggle cursed power on/off

Enemies: 
-Aliens: These aliens are fast and strong and release stinky air out of their skin when damaged.

Relics: 
-New Relic: The sword in the barrel!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/98df1a209162eaec3f1baff0bf31138358f25009.png
Use this relic to upgrade the amount of damage your attacks deal
-Apple Cider: (Health Upgrade): Reduced the amount of healing to prevent going over max health. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/3be9e600f0e8a6604d1258313b4b75cdc46ba1c2.png
-Pumpkin Turret: Increased health, damage, and projectile size of the pumpkin turret. Pumpkin turrets now constantly drain health similarly to pumpkin pals. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/729d0eef1db11379c49c881a441f128ae2efbd55.png

Endless: 
-Added Sword in the barrel to all endless maps

Achievements: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906459/91cd305382ab04256a5f9cbcb0ec2109cd0f9420.png
-There is currently a very small amount of unlockable achievements with a lot more on the way. Stay tuned for more achievements and the hats you can unlock from them!

Bugfixes/minor changes:
-Fixed some instances of levels spawning you as the wrong character 
-Fixed random donuts in the sewer intro cutscene
-Added player numbers to the cursors on the character select screen
-Changed Pumpkin masters projectile sound 
-Fixed pumpkin master playing the incorrect sound upon defeat 
-Updated some collisions on level 5
-Fixed some cutscenes not being skippable

Coming in Update 1.5:
-More Achievements
-Unlockable hats for Characters
-New total score stat for endless mode 
-Endless mode starting Ice Cream bonus
-Co-op for endless mode

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
New Content: 
-The apple orchard is now a possible map you can get in endless mode 

Changes: 
-Pumpkin Masters pumpkin pals now lose 1 health per second.
-Pumpkin pals always have their health bar above them to show how much longer they will be alive
-Pumpkin Pals damage dealt has been doubled
-Pumpkin Pals speed has been increased
-Added new animation and sounds for when the pumpkin master summons a pumpkin pal
-Pumpkin Pals size has been doubled 
-Pumpkin pals now make unique sounds when damaged
-Audio now plays when interacting with relics 
-When leveling the apple cider barrel, the player now heals extra to make it more noticeable their health has improved.
-In Co-op time based relics now give 5 seconds instead of 10, to balance out the fact that both player get the bonus
-In Co-op the cider barrel (Health Upgrade) costs 1 more ice cream per level to balance out there being 2 players. 

Bugfixes: 
-Fixed a bug that caused fresh air to disappear when using a melee attack as Troy Collins
-Fixed Pumpkin Master not being able to use Ice Cream makers. 
-Fixed Pumpkin Master not being able to use Air freshener
-Fixed Fierce Joe dealing no damage 
-Fixed Knife clowns hitboxes
-Fixed a bug that caused you to load into episode 2 if you are defeated on episode 5
-Fixed one of the sock piles in episode 3 not spawning air freshener when destroyed

notes.title: Fun House Trap Update! (1.2)
notes.content:
Story:
-Added 2 player split-screen to episodes 1-4
-Added episode 6

Enemies: 
-Watcher: The watcher is a living eyeball that shoots exploding eyeballs that track you down. You can attack the eyes to destroy them before they get to you!
-Ms.Fortune: Ms.Fortune shoots crystal orbs that apply the cure status effect to the player. She also has a crystal ball shield around her that protects her and enemies near her from ranged attacks

Gameplay:
-Curse: Curse reduces the player's movement speed. The more cursed you are, the more damage you take from crystal orb attacks
-Water Cooler: Using Ice Cream at a water cooler gives the player the hydrated status effect. Well hydrated you move faster. The more hydrated you are the quicker the curse effect goes away

Endless:
-Added the water cooler to the city map
-Added the sewers as a 2nd map you can randomly get
-Added all enemies in the story so far to the endless

Coming next week on 8/2: 
-Episode 7 
-Local Co-op for episodes 5, 6, and 7. 
-Local Co-op for Endless mode 
-The genie as a new support character for Co-op
-New maps for endless
-New enemy types
-Steam achievements
-Unlockable hats
